title: Form submit reloads the page around handleSubmit
message: This submit handler calls the form's handleSubmit without event.preventDefault(), so the browser still performs a native full-page form submission and the app reloads mid-submit. Call event.preventDefault() before handleSubmit().
help: Wrap the submit handler as onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); form.handleSubmit(); }} because TanStack Form's handleSubmit never cancels the native submit itself.

title: Large component is hard to read and change
message: Component "MfaVerification" is over 300 lines long, which is hard to read & change. Split it into a few smaller components.
help: Pull each section into its own component so the parent is easier to read, test, and change.
